title: French skincare brand La Rosée steps up its pharmacy expansion
summary: Founded in 2015 by two pharmacists, La Rosée has established itself over the past decade as a leading dermo-cosmetic brand in the pharmacy channel. Available in more than 11,000 pharmacies, the brand continues to expand in France and internationally, building on its distinctive approach combining naturally derived ingredients, eco-design and pharmaceutical expertise.
